item.title: Daily Podcast 2026-10-29
item.description: The fundamental problem that's been hiding in plain sight in protein design is that proteins simply refuse to sit still in a tensor. | RFdiffusion3 fills unused Atom14 slots with virtual atoms placed on the CB, or on CA for glycine, so that all fourteen points can be denoised without ever committing to a residue identity. | What ties these three together is a shared recognition that the chicken-and-egg problem between structure and sequence is not a bug to be patched but a design principle to be embraced.
